# Check left and right bounds of pot bottom in obs_0031
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0031.png'))
# Find all columns where bottom of pot touches the floor
pot_contacts = []
for c in range(200, 270):
    for r in range(460, 410, -1):
        if img[r, c, 0] > 100 and img[r, c, 1] < 100 and img[r, c, 2] < 50:
            pot_contacts.append((c, r))
            break

print('Pot bottom contact left:', pot_contacts[0])
print('Pot bottom contact right:', pot_contacts[-1])
print('Center col:', (pot_contacts[0][0] + pot_contacts[-1][0]) / 2)
